description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing surveys within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and activating/deactivating surveys, utilizing annotations for Swagger documentation, Jersey REST interfaces, and Spring components.

classes.name: SpmApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing survey management endpoints, including listing, retrieval, creation, update, and activation/deactivation functionalities.

methods.name: fetchAllSurveys
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all surveys, with optional filtering for active surveys.

methods.name: findSurvey
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch a specific survey by ID.

methods.name: createSurvey
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new survey with provided data.

methods.name: editSurvey
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing survey identified by ID.

methods.name: activateOrDeactivateSurvey
methods.description: Handles POST request to activate or deactivate a survey based on command parameter.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Utility method to generate JSON response containing resource ID after create/update operations.
